definitions.full: H6314. pugath מּוּגַת (Ges § 80f ) noun feminine benumbing (figurative), cessation; — פ ׳אַלתִּֿתְּנִי לָךְ Lam 2:18 grant thyself no benumbing (read probably מּוּגֹת ).
